about: Receiving-water names in Georgia's spill reports (EPD's Municipal Sewage Spills list: the daily list and every dated posting from 2025-10-09 to 2026-11-04, 1,366 records; and EPA's Sewer Overflow and Bypass Event reports for GA permits, 894 records, 629 of them the same spill as an EPD row) as typed (case and punctuation ignored), each counted once per spill, with the number of spills giving it: every name, whether or not a water record holds it, so each has a record or a stated reason. Spelling variants of a held water (Polebridge Creek, Sugar Crek, Ocmuglee) are listed as typed so an alias can be added. Built by scripts/ga_report_water_names.py.
